summary: Validated iteration-22 changes to /app/ebms-adapter/ebms-orchestrator/src/main/resources/static/admin/index.html: (a) cpaId now extracted via namespace-agnostic getLenientAttribute -> avoids the HTTP 409 on overwrite; (b) new Delete CPA button + confirm modal wired correctly. Served static admin dashboard via python http.server:8765; injected a fetch mock that mimics cpa-service (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE) since the Java stack (Spring Boot + PostgreSQL + RabbitMQ) is not runnable inside this preview pod (no docker, no postgres). Executed the full round-trip flow for 3 namespace variants: tp: prefix (TEST-CPA-409), no prefix (TEST-CPA-PLAIN), and cpa: prefix (TEST-CPA-CPANS). All three: first upload -> POST 201 (no 409), edit End date + re-upload same file -> UI detected exists, showed data-testid=overwrite-confirm-modal, click confirm -> PUT 200 with the new endDate persisted; Delete button (data-testid=cpa-delete-button) opens data-testid=delete-confirm-modal with the correct cpaId in data-testid=delete-modal-cpa-id; Cancel keeps CPA; Confirm triggers DELETE, backend mock returns 204, UI resets (cpaMeta shows 'Nog geen CPA geladen', networkMap shows 'Geen partijen om te tonen.', cpa-status-toggle-wrap hidden, cpa-upload-button disabled); subsequent GET /api/cpa/{id} returns 404. parseCpaXml also verified directly returning correct cpaId+partyName for all 3 namespace variants (regression check for the previously-fixed partyName lenient parsing).
action_items: Optional: The Java stack could not be started in this pod (needs docker-compose with PostgreSQL x2 + RabbitMQ). Consider a slim H2/testcontainers profile for future automated end-to-end tests. Live backend PUT/DELETE were NOT hit against the real Spring Boot service; only against a JS fetch mock that replicates the expected contract.
critical_code_review_comments: getLenientAttribute is now correctly reused for both cpaId (line 371) and partyName (line 383) in parseCpaXml. Case-insensitive localName lookup handles any namespace prefix.

Consistency note (out of scope, not a bug): Status@value (line 374), PartyId@type (line 386), Endpoint@uri (line 389), and Certificate/X509Certificate lookups still use plain getAttribute and getElementsByTagNameNS. In the tp:-prefixed fixture this made Status/oinType/endpoint come back empty because they are prefixed attributes (tp:value/tp:type/tp:uri). Not a regression from this iteration, but visible in the CPA-details UI. Applying getLenientAttribute here as well would round out the fix.
Delete modal handler correctly nulls lastParsedCpa/lastRawXml/currentCpaDto, resets meta+network map placeholders, hides status toggle wrap, and disables cpaUploadBtn - matches spec.
showDeleteConfirm/showOverwriteConfirm properly add+remove listeners via cleanup(); no listener leak on repeated open/close cycles.
Delete flow accepts !res.ok && res.status !== 204 correctly (204 is technically ok in fetch so the second check is defensive).

rca of the issue: Original bug: cpaUploadBtn.onclick calls parseCpaXml which extracts cpaId; before the fix it used root.getAttribute('cpaid')||root.getAttribute('cpaId'), missing any XML where the attribute is namespace-prefixed like tp:cpaId. Result: cpaId parsed as '(onbekend)', GET /api/cpa/(onbekend) returned 404, code took the POST branch, backend correctly rejected the duplicate real cpaId (which was in the XML body) with 409 CPA_ALREADY_EXISTS. Fix: reuse getLenientAttribute(root,'cpaId') which iterates root.attributes and matches on localName case-insensitively, correctly resolving cpaId regardless of prefix. Verified: with tp:cpaId, plain cpaId, cpa:cpaId - all three now yield the correct id, so the GET-check returns 200, the UI shows the overwrite-confirm-modal, and the subsequent request is a PUT (not a POST), persisting the new end date.
